original_ai_output.title_zh: 东赤道州部署1722名疫苗接种员开展脊髓灰质炎接种活动
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹东赤道州卫生当局启动为期四天的脊髓灰质炎疫苗接种活动，部署1722名接种员和159名监督员，覆盖社区儿童。活动采用nOPV2和bOPV两种口服疫苗，通过入户及市场等临时接种点推进。世界卫生组织、联合国儿童基金会等合作伙伴参与支持。

location.raw_text: Eastern Equatoria state, Torit Freedom Square

key_facts.fact: 东赤道州卫生当局启动为期四天的脊髓灰质炎疫苗接种活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Health authorities in Eastern Equatoria state have launched a four-day polio vaccination campaign

key_facts.fact: 活动部署1722名接种员和159名监督员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the campaign would deploy 1,722 vaccinators and 159 supervisors to improve immunization coverage

key_facts.fact: 接种活动使用nOPV2和bOPV两种口服疫苗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The campaign will use two oral vaccines: the novel oral polio vaccine type 2 (nOPV2), which targets poliovirus type 2, and the bivalent oral polio vaccine (bOPV), which protects against types 1 and 3

key_facts.fact: 接种团队将采用入户方式并在市场等公共场所设立临时接种点
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: teams would use a house-to-house approach, alongside temporary vaccination posts at markets and other public gathering places

key_facts.fact: 世界卫生组织、联合国儿童基金会等合作伙伴参与支持
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Dr. Emmanuel Timothy, representing the World Health Organization (WHO)... Osuru Peter, representing the United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF)

uncertainties: 该事件目前为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
